purpose: Record only provenance relationships corroborated by retained registry/audit artifacts. This file is not a source-code migration manifest.

global_namespace_boundary.rule: P2424 and T2424 remain separate namespaces unless an explicit evidence-backed crosswalk proves a relationship.

corroborated_aliases.evidence_boundary: Retained MODEL-PST handoff reports a complete isolated synthetic-controlled package under /mnt/data/pst_prompt6_bundle/projects/MODEL-PST. A separate Typhon task registry maps MODEL-008 to canonical_name PST. Neither retained artifact supplies the missing source archive bytes inside the current Git repository.
negative_findings_to_preserve: raw-expression logistic and linear logistic-pair controls outperform the neural PST model on the controlled generator
validation-only calibration worsens multiple metrics relative to the raw score
four-dimensional latent bottleneck is weaker/unstable across seeds
variance selection can discard controlled transition signal
family-A to family-B transfer is weak relative to family-B in-domain retraining

corroborated_aliases.evidence_boundary: Retained MODEL-NPMS handoff and experiment report describe the isolated synthetic-controlled package and match the canonical recovered experiment-report metrics/hashes. A separate Typhon task registry maps MODEL-007 to canonical_name NPMS. The exact original source/config/raw-log tree is still not present in current Git identity.
negative_findings_to_preserve: compact delay-PCA linear-mode recovery is substantially worse than identity smoke recovery
multiscale AR spectral recovery remains weak
negative switching regime is poorly recovered
matched-eigenvalue metric ignores unmatched spurious/missing modes
mode truncation ranks individual eigenvalues rather than conjugate groups
frequency response is an autonomous-operator resolvent proxy rather than a full input-output transfer function

candidate_aliases_requiring_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: A retained MODEL-PEN handoff reports a complete isolated /mnt/data/typhon-omega/projects/MODEL-PEN package with source, six passing tests, benchmark protocol, multi-seed synthetic-controlled experiments, ablations, robustness runs, manuscript and SHA-256 workspace records. The provisional handoff explicitly states that no Project 2424 registry was mounted, so T2424-0033 must not be assigned automatically despite the close PEN name match.
negative_findings_to_preserve: PEN only slightly beats the no-memory control on three synthetic-controlled seeds
random-write memory is slightly better than PEN on mean predictive MSE
attention-only is better than PEN on predictive and causal-event MSE
retrieval precision is low and interference is high
the first compact objective collapsed salience/write activity and remains preserved as an invalidated run
